dmn_experiences.title: The Manchester Craft Beer Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Manchester's craft beer venues with tastings across several stops, covering the brewing process and a range of beer styles. Groups are capped at 25 people.
highlights: Guided tour of Manchester's craft beer scene
Tastings of styles from IPAs to wild-fermented beers
Small groups of up to 25 people
Wheelchair-accessible route of about one mile

dmn_experiences.title: Runaway Brewery tours
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Runaway Brewery in Ardwick led by the brewing team, with tastings of four beers and a walk through the production process.
highlights: Tour of the working brewery led by the team
Tastings of four beers
See malt and smell hops up close
Sample from the tank when available

dmn_experiences.title: Beer Nouveau Brewery Tours
dmn_experiences.summary: A behind-the-scenes tour of Beer Nouveau in Ardwick, hosted by the brewer, taking in the equipment and brewing process with tastings along the way.
highlights: Hosted tour of the brewing equipment
Beer tastings throughout
Traditional techniques with modern ingredients
A short walk from Manchester Piccadilly

dmn_experiences.title: Manchester Gin Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A behind-the-scenes tour of The Spirit of Manchester Distillery followed by a guided tasting of five award-winning Manchester Gins.
highlights: Behind-the-scenes distillery tour
Guided tasting of five gins
10% discount on the bar bill and merchandise
Several daily time slots

dmn_experiences.title: Gin Masterclass First Saturdays at 2pm
dmn_experiences.summary: A gin masterclass for two at The Liquor Store on Deansgate, covering gin history, botanicals and distillation, with a welcome G&T and a tasting of four gins.
highlights: Welcome G&T on arrival
Tutored tasting of four gins
Learn about gin history and distillation
Explore a range of botanicals
